scope: Appendix E Revit views, project templates, and category/subcategory graphics

sources.title: View Standards – Instructions, Definitions, Workflows
sources.notes: Durable instruction and ATS already existed. Round 001 adds the missing machine-readable mapping fields while leaving source example names and recommended settings noncanonical.

sources.title: Revit Project Templates – Instructions, Definitions, Workflows
sources.notes: Template governance and ATS already existed. Round 001 adds the missing manifest fields; actual approved template catalogue entries remain future governed data, not inferred from placeholders.

sources.title: Category & Subcategory Graphics Standards and Guidelines
sources.notes: Graphics-control hierarchy was already migrated. Round 001 adds the machine-readable control fields but intentionally does not promote example lineweights, colors, hatch names, or subcategory names marked for confirmation.

sources.title: Annotation Standards – Instructions, Definitions, Workflows
sources.notes: Annotation is adjacent but not part of Round 001. Existing L6 instruction is retained; controlled annotation catalogue and parameter/tag mappings will be reconciled in a later Revit round.

rules: Source examples and TODO-bound values are not canonicalized without explicit governed approval.
Current-main objects are enriched rather than duplicated.
Round 001 creates executable registry structure; approved enterprise values may be populated only from governed source authority or curator decision.
